body:
TermAl coordinator operating procedure: the canonical home for current coordinator rules, created 2026-10-25 by Fable2. It mirrors Engram rules-roles-and-council r7, MEMORY UPKEEP. Memory grants no authority. Older single-incident coordinator-* memories remain as history; fold current guidance in here when one is next revised.

MEMORY UPKEEP (Greg DIRECT to Architect3, 2026-10-25: "jezeli dostaniesz raport bledow wspolpracy, zmien reguly"; follow-up: "i upewnij sie, ze inni je otrzymali"; relayed in TermAl mailbox 63096d00 #23):
On a collaboration-failure report, inspect the facts and correct the responsible operating rule without another request from Greg. Revise its existing canonical memory; retain only current guidance in the body. Keep incident evidence and discarded assumptions in task notes/history. Check the current full readback and communicate the correction to affected agents. Verify its effect on the next real handoff. Preserve Greg's decisions and reserved authority. Retire ended workarounds and update references; each workaround names its retirement item.
Coordinators convey relevant corrections to affected active coders when a concrete incident requires them, using the complete current rule.
Publication (Engram rules-merger-role r12, 63096d00 #49): before publishing or forwarding a correction received by mail, read the currently available pages in that rule's thread and reconcile superseding or withdrawn instructions; publish the current agreed text. If a later withdrawal arrives, correct promptly and record whether any action used the old wording. Record actual delivery/publication times; do not assume knowledge of a queued unread message. No approval wait.

SINGLE EDITOR (Engram rules-merger-role r6, Architect3 63096d00 #30): each canonical procedure has one named editor. Merger2 edits merger-operating-procedure; Fable2 sends corrections to Merger2 and never writes that key. Fable2 edits this key.

ARCHITECT3 ROUTING (Greg DIRECT in Architect3's session, 2026-10-25: "Termal::Merger2 nie powien ci raportowac normalnych statusow. tylko cos tam gdzie zawodzi praca twoja rola jest poprawa wspolpracy i poinformowanie innych"; Engram rules-merger-role r7, rules-architect-escalation-boundary r2; 63096d00 #32):
Architect3 receives only concrete collaboration failures needing a workflow/rule correction: failed interaction, evidence, impact, current owner; also report them to Advisor (relay to Greg). Routine START/PASS/FAIL, READY/accepted, queue/landing/install and repair progress go to the task and to Fable2, never Architect3. A product test failure goes to Architect3 only when it exposes a collaboration failure. Never name Architect3 as a test --notify recipient, result relay or recovery owner; Fable2 and Merger2 own operational recovery and results. Do not interrupt or rerun a gate to change routing. No routine success-confirmation mail to Architect3. Greg-directed architecture questions may go to Architect3 (e.g. Advisor b9d13887 #1902).

SUCCESSOR ROUTING (merger-operating-procedure r18; incident on TermAl w-a1a640ca5802): resolve a replacement session by its live exact id, actual projectId/workdir AND tracker/tool binding, never by name (Greg's Engram merger is session-14575 "Termal::Merger3" in the Engram project). Verify these before routing a queue or offer to it. After a recreation, owners rediscover and re-address native offers; delivery to a removed session is not receipt by its successor. Each project's coordinator owns its own successor routing.

HOST-WIDE FULL-GATE SLOT: one full gate at a time across TermAl and Engram. Fable2 grants it: Termal::Merger2 and Engram's Merger3 ask for GO before each full gate; installs stay outside a running gate (hold, then release on the installed report). Waits on another project's runs are refused by the host; recover from the saved summary after the agreed deadline. A gate failure caused by a pre-existing defect gets that defect fixed BEFORE the gate re-runs (precedent w-9394, 2026-10-25; again w-c51b6b414885 for gate test-8930f448); no unchanged re-gate.

CODEX REVIEW FOLLOW-UP 500 (interim, set 2026-10-25 23:44Z; retires with w-54b31236feca): when a Codex review child's follow-up fails with "timed out waiting for Codex app-server response to `thread/unarchive`", the producer replaces it with ONE fresh Codex whole-input reviewer on the same frozen input, records the occurrence on w-54b31236feca, and discloses it in the READY. No retry of the failed thread, no Kimi stand-in (Codex is available). Applies to that exact failure only.

REPORTING (applied 2026-10-25): report a memory, tracker or config write only after the tool's actual success response and a readback. Never report intended revisions. A revise refused because another session holds the claim is NOT a write: say so, record concurrence as a note, and ask the holder to revise.
